newsitem.title: USA: Patriot Scientific to acquire Metacomp.
newsitem.headline: Patriot Scientific to acquire Metacomp.

text.p: Patriot Scientific Corp said on Monday it has signed a letter of intent to acquire at least 90 percent of Metacomp Inc, a maker of high-performance digital telecommunication products in San Diego, Calif.
Terms of the deal include a stock exchange valued at about $2.5 million. The deal is expected to close in December.
Metacomp posted revenues of more than $2 million for the fiscal year ended July 31. It is on track for significant growth for 1997, Patriot Scientific said in a statement.
"The acquisition of Metacomp brings strength and market focus to our communications products," said Michael Carenzo, chief executive officer.
